text: Sage, this machine shop looks so busy. Why is everyone running around?
Because nothing is connected. Let me show you a normal day.
A customer sends bars for job work. Whose material is on which rack? It's in a spreadsheet. Maybe.
Maybe?!
On the floor, route cards are on paper and counts are written by hand. To know if a machine is running, someone walks over and asks.
So the machine knows, but the office doesn't?
Exactly. And before dispatch, the inspection records and the certificate are put together by hand.
Then the invoice and the e-way bill are typed again, and once more into Tally.
That's the same work, three times!
Now the same day with Synax Manufacturing ERP. From the machine spindle to the GST invoice, in one workspace.
One workspace? Show me one part.
It starts with the customer P O. Every line is quoted, every revision is kept, and the open quantity shows what is still to ship.
And the customer's bars?
They're booked in at the gate against the challan, with their material I D range. Then they're tracked through issue, consumption, returns and scrap, one to one against every invoiced part.
Then production?
A route card is released against the bill of materials, and the material is reserved, so the same stock is never promised twice.
And the counts?
The operator scans the route card to start. The machine proposes the cycle count, and the operator confirms it, with a reason if it differs.
No more walking over to ask!
Inspection, FAIR and the certificate of conformance carry the machining record. Then packing, the GST invoice, the I R N and the e-way bill, in one flow. The vouchers go across to Tally.
So each document carries the one before it?
Yes. Any part traces back to its P O, material lot, machine and operator.
One more thing. Who keeps an eye on all of this?
Meet the Synax agents. They watch for challans past their return date, orders ready to dispatch, and quality compliance, and they propose the fix.
Do they act on their own?
No. Nothing changes until an approver with the right role says yes, and every decision is recorded.
Smart helpers, and people in charge. I like it!
Synax Manufacturing ERP. From the spindle to the invoice.
